name: Toozi
summary: Handles books, invoices, savings reminders and e-filing for US self-employed people by text.
description: Toozi is an SMS tax app for the US self-employed: it keeps books (separate books per hustle), sends invoices, tells you what to save, and e-files a federal return (Form 1040 with supporting forms, as described on the pricing FAQ). Cancel anytime, per the official FAQ.
features: Taxes by text for the US self-employed
